flow.description: this flow is used to transform data for dimensions and facts.
flow.name: Transform flow

labels.label:
This processor transforms on dim_currency as below:
+ Formats name, code to upper case
+ Convert latitude, longitude to Decimal(9,6)

This code consists of transformation:
+ convert firstname, lastname, title, country to title case
+ format ‘phone’ field to 85515123456
+ convert province,district,commune,village to title case
+ convert ‘maritial_status’ field to title case
+ convert to format like this: Male, Female, Other, Prefer-Not-To-Say
+ restrict latitude, longitude with decimal(9,6)

This script performs the following transformations:
+ Fallback null or empty fields with default values (-1, "N/A").
+ Convert text fields (e.g., order_name, customer_note, payment_term) to uppercase or fallback string.
+ Map enumerated status fields:
- invoice_status: No → Quotation, To Invoice → To-Invoice, Invoiced → Invoiced
- order_state: Draft, Sent, Waiting, Sale, Done, Cancel
- shipping_policy: Direct → ASAP, One → All-Products
+ Convert timestamp fields (in epoch milliseconds) into integer yyyyMMdd format (Asia/Bangkok timezone).

This script performs the following transformations:
+ Fallbacks for null or blank fields (-1, "N/A").
+ Converts epoch millis to yyyyMMdd format (Asia/Bangkok timezone).
+ Maps order_discount_type and order_line_discount_type to "Fixed" or "Percent"; defaults to "N/A".
+ Computes gross and net order line amounts
+ Derives untaxed discount amount based on type (fixed or percentage).
